description: New-user journey, stages 2-3: fresh install -> /cold-start-interview quick start writes a populated practice profile + shared company-profile.md; then a SECOND plugin's cold-start must READ the shared profile and NOT re-ask the company questions. Assertions are primarily filesystem side-effects (deterministic) plus lightweight transcript checks. Runs headless via `claude -p` against a sandboxed HOME. See README.md.

turns.note: Fresh sandbox. Quick 2-min start with all answers pre-supplied so headless has no interactive Q&A to block on.
turns.prompt: Run /employment-legal-uk:cold-start-interview as the QUICK 2-minute start. Do not ask me questions one at a time - here are all my answers, use them and WRITE THE CONFIG FILES TO DISK NOW. Role = Lawyer / legal professional. Practice setting = In-house. Company = Acme Widgets Ltd. Industry = SaaS software. Employees = 200. Nations with employees = England & Wales and Scotland. No international employees. HR lead = Jo Smith. Employment counsel = me (in-house). Use sensible defaults for everything else. You MUST call the Write tool to create both the per-plugin practice profile and the shared company-profile.md before you finish.

fs_assertions.why: cold-start must persist the per-plugin practice profile
first plugin must write the shared company profile the others read
profile should capture the company name given in the interview
both stated nations should be recorded
unwritten template has 29 [PLACEHOLDER; a real quick-start resolves most to defaults and leaves ~12. >=25 means it barely ran.
[DEFAULT markers prove quick-start actively filled sensible defaults (unwritten template has 0)

transcript_assertions.why: the run should be about setup, not something else

turns.note: Same sandbox HOME -> company-profile.md from t1 persists on disk. Second plugin must read it and skip the company questions. Cascades: if t1 did not write the profile, this stage's read-and-skip cannot pass.
turns.prompt: Run /commercial-legal-uk:cold-start-interview as the quick start. If a shared company profile already exists, read it and confirm it back to me rather than re-asking the company questions.

fs_assertions.why: second plugin should reuse the shared profile, not overwrite it

transcript_assertions.why: should acknowledge the shared profile it read
must NOT re-ask company questions the shared profile already answers
